title: Organization profile
description: Values specific to one organization: the answers of the Copier templates, and the settings applied through the GitHub API. The file lives in the private administration repository of the organization.

website.description: Public website of the team; empty if none

contact_url.description: Page that external people use to contact the team; empty if none

apoikia_repo.description: Repository holding the reusable workflows, as <owner>/<name>

apoikia_ref.description: Tag or commit of apoikia that the generated workflows call

admin_name.description: Person to whom questions about the guidelines are addressed; empty until decided

admin_email.description: Email address of that person; empty until decided

maintainer.description: Maintainer to notify when sensitive content is committed (Markdown allowed); empty until decided

data_storage.description: Storage location of the datasets, as a noun phrase; empty until decided

external_contributions_policy.description: Sentence stating whether external contributors may open issues and pull requests; empty until decided

release_archive.description: Service archiving the releases of publications with a DOI; empty until decided

publication_policy.description: Sentence stating when a study repository is made public and whether it is archived; empty until decided

license_policy.description: Default licenses, as a parenthetical; empty until decided

topics.description: Topics set on repositories; empty until decided

settings.description: Organization settings applied through the GitHub API

default_repository_permission.description: Base permission of members on every repository

actions.description: Actions policy of the organization; `selected` must allow the reusable workflows of apoikia

patterns_allowed.description: Patterns of the actions and reusable workflows allowed when `allowed_actions` is `selected`

repositories.description: Repositories that the organization holds, with the apoikia template rendering each instance

template.description: Value of the `template` answer of apoikia; absent for a repository not rendered from apoikia

labels.description: Labels created in every repository; must include the labels used by the issue forms (`task`, `bug`)
